assessment_type: source-only targeted editorial reassessment of pattern.master-detail on the proposed PR #42 branch; other 91 ratings carried forward from the earlier 2026-11-19 source-only assessment; not an independent human review, verified consumer implementation, accessibility audit, user study or production outcome

evidence_levels.E1: Independent human review and source applicability checked
evidence_levels.E2: Relevant implementation or representative task test
evidence_levels.E3: Adopted with documented outcomes and owner

concepts.title: Design principles
concepts.explanation: The one-minute task hierarchy, precise applicability, representative appointment case, focused acceptance rubric and scoped visual-hierarchy sources now define observable choices without art-direction duplication.
concepts.next_action: Have an independent reviewer and representative users compare the appointment hierarchy, safe action order, recovery and inclusive variants; log observed mistakes and uncertainties.

concepts.title: Visual design craftsmanship
concepts.explanation: The five-decision visual-direction method and source-aware comparisons are strong; later art-direction, acceptance and handoff sections repeat selection guidance and slow scanning.
concepts.next_action: Consolidate repeated selection and acceptance rules into one agent-first route, keeping optical, typography and research depth linked.

concepts.title: Practical UI styling recipes
concepts.explanation: The recipe chooser, token-backed CSS and inclusive checks are substantial; the long archetype, utility and review sections repeat ownership decisions across sections.
concepts.next_action: Keep the recipe chooser prominent and trim repeated ownership/evidence notes; test first-hit lookup on a representative styling task.

concepts.title: Icon semantics and accessible icon controls
concepts.explanation: Role-first icon semantics and accessible host states are strong; overlapping role-classification and registry/audit tables still add unnecessary search steps.
concepts.next_action: Combine repeated role decisions and link audit detail from a compact choose-host-name-verify route; test agent icon-only lookup.

concepts.title: Design tokens and themes
concepts.explanation: Semantic ownership is explicit; the DTCG-scoped, valid token sample, release gates, theme boundaries and migration/rollback checks form a concise, testable source-only contract.
concepts.next_action: Run typed-token conversion and consumer contrast/focus checks on the target toolchain; record actual supported mode, converter version, owner and rollback result.

concepts.title: Component model
concepts.explanation: A single reuse/composition decision route, verified-source boundaries, explicit consumer inventory and incremental recovery checks now make ownership clear without duplicate migration matrices.
concepts.next_action: Independently evaluate the decision path on actual Button, Dialog and feature consumers; record task-to-file errors, keyboard and migration outcomes before changing E0.

concepts.title: Component contracts
concepts.explanation: A minimum component contract and fast path now make state, API, event and evidence ownership easier to find; extensive specialist sections still add reading cost.
concepts.next_action: Validate the minimum contract with one real Button or Dialog adoption and reduce repeated specialist details that do not change a decision.

concepts.title: Task flows and information architecture
concepts.explanation: Task-first journeys and structural alternatives are covered; extensive capability and wireframe sections slow retrieval.
concepts.next_action: Add a compact task-to-flow checklist and index the specialized cases.

concepts.title: Role-aware workspaces and context switching
concepts.explanation: Preview, impersonation and authorization are correctly distinguished with scenario coverage; product evidence is still absent.
concepts.next_action: Validate a multi-role switching task and keep identity rules separate from visual affordances.

concepts.title: Interaction states and recovery
concepts.explanation: A recovery chooser now puts failed, partial and uncertain outcomes before specialized flows, and status tables use one evidence convention; the long reference still needs trimming.
concepts.next_action: Test loss-of-acknowledgement and focus recovery in a real flow, then consolidate redundant examples and state notes.

concepts.title: Accessibility
concepts.explanation: The obsolete iframe and preview claims are gone; a WCAG-scoped catalog-versus-product matrix and task acceptance scenarios now lead the guidance. Real consuming-product checks remain unperformed.
concepts.next_action: Carry out keyboard, screen-reader, reflow, theme and RTL checks on a real consuming journey; record browser, assistive technology, product version and results.

concepts.title: Internationalization and bidirectional support
concepts.explanation: RTL, formatting and translation growth have clear verification rules; no real localized interface evidence is recorded.
concepts.next_action: Add one representative pseudolocalization and RTL task record.

concepts.title: UX measurement
concepts.explanation: The task-first metric definition, explicit denominators, modality-aware effort worksheet, first-hit discovery protocol and source-limited hypotheses make collection, analysis and safeguards reproducible.
concepts.next_action: Pilot the metric instruments and catalog findability tasks with eligible participants, documenting missingness, denominators, privacy review, source revision and uncertainty.

concepts.title: Catalog lifecycle and decision policy
concepts.explanation: Lifecycle states and reuse decisions are explicit; no assigned owner or accepted review currently supports promotion.
concepts.next_action: Attach a minimal owner and evidence gate before moving any concept out of proposed.

concepts.title: Design and catalog quality gates
concepts.explanation: A short decision-oriented gate index and shared evidence legend reduce repeated status-cell noise, but the long collection of specialized matrices still slows scanning.
concepts.next_action: Review whether remaining specialized matrices can be linked or condensed without losing release-critical coverage; test reviewer task lookup.

concepts.title: Button
concepts.explanation: The native action-versus-link boundary now has a concrete double-activation Save case with pending, focus and duplicate-prevention checks; consuming behavior remains unverified.
concepts.next_action: Test Enter, Space and repeated pointer activation in a real consumer; confirm one mutation, visible pending state, focus and localized error recovery.

concepts.title: Input
concepts.explanation: The native input contract now demonstrates IME composition, deferred validation and correction without lost caret or entry; platform-specific behavior needs testing.
concepts.next_action: Exercise IME composition, server validation, caret retention, long translations, zoom and mixed-direction input across supported browsers.

concepts.title: Select
concepts.explanation: The native Select versus Combobox choice is clearer with a no-available-regions case, empty-state reasoning and option refresh checks; product behavior is not tested.
concepts.next_action: Verify no-choice and refreshed-choice selection, keyboard access, disabled reasons, accessible names and translated option labels.

concepts.title: Checkbox
concepts.explanation: The mixed Select all case makes group aggregation, disabled-child handling and independent choice semantics concrete; actual screen-reader output is unknown.
concepts.next_action: Test all, none and mixed selection with disabled children, Space activation, group labeling and spoken state updates.

concepts.title: Dialog
concepts.explanation: A list-row confirmation example specifies Escape and focus return alongside background inertness and error recovery, making acceptance more concrete; no runtime test is claimed.
concepts.next_action: Check initial focus, modal Tab containment, Escape, focus return after a row disappears, reflow and long translated content.

concepts.title: Field and error
concepts.explanation: An invalid-email correction example makes label, help, error and domain-validation ownership actionable, with explicit preservation of input and focus.
concepts.next_action: Test a failed and corrected email submission, linked descriptions, nonduplicated announcement, translated error text and retained input.

concepts.title: Form composition and validation
concepts.explanation: Field planning, validation and submission recovery are operational; it lacks independent task-completion evidence.
concepts.next_action: Test one failed submission and recovery flow with representative users.

concepts.title: Navigation and wayfinding
concepts.explanation: Route-state and wayfinding contracts are compact; a multi-level navigation case would make the guidance easier to apply.
concepts.next_action: Add a representative nested navigation and current-location example.

concepts.title: Search and filtering
concepts.explanation: The documentation browser now ranks exact identities, aliases and primary task phrases before related results, with deterministic and Chromium checks; user findability is unmeasured.
concepts.next_action: Conduct a small task-based findability check with representative vocabulary, keyboard navigation and zero-results recovery; retain ranked-search regression tests.

concepts.title: Data tables and collection actions
concepts.explanation: Table versus grid choices and accessible row actions are specific; applied keyboard and reflow evidence is absent.
concepts.next_action: Verify row actions, sorting and a narrow layout in a real table example.

concepts.title: Feedback and status messaging
concepts.explanation: In-task status and cross-channel notifications are differentiated; durable recovery treatment needs a demonstrated flow.
concepts.next_action: Add one lost-acknowledgement outcome and persistent recovery case.

concepts.title: UX research methods and evidence
concepts.explanation: Method selection, study protocol and inference limits are well defined; the repository records no completed studies.
concepts.next_action: Connect the template to a future actual study without presenting hypothetical results as findings.

concepts.title: Mental models and journey mapping
concepts.explanation: Journey contracts and mental-model mismatch examples are easy to follow; their use is not demonstrated with participants.
concepts.next_action: Add a sourced journey example and a validated decision change.

concepts.title: Cognitive load and decision design
concepts.explanation: Concise decisions and anti-examples reduce unnecessary complexity; dense collaborative annotation is not explicitly linked.
concepts.next_action: Cross-link annotation prioritization and provide a cluttered-review task example.

concepts.title: Content design and UX writing
concepts.explanation: Content-by-state and error-copy rules are actionable; repeated evidence caveats marginally distract from copy decisions.
concepts.next_action: Add a compact state-copy worksheet and consolidate caveats.

concepts.title: Service recovery and support handoff
concepts.explanation: Recovery decision trees and support handoff states cover failure well; no connected service scenario is validated.
concepts.next_action: Run one self-service-to-support handoff and task-resumption test.

concepts.title: Privacy, consent and trustworthy UX
concepts.explanation: Consent and privacy decisions include state and source context; appended account lifecycle material adds scope and repetition.
concepts.next_action: Separate universal privacy choices from product-specific settings journeys.

concepts.title: Authentication and account lifecycle
concepts.explanation: Sign-in, MFA, session expiry and recovery boundaries are comprehensive; security and assistive tests are not recorded.
concepts.next_action: Recheck current source applicability and validate a reauthentication flow.

concepts.title: Notifications and attention management
concepts.explanation: Urgency, delivery, deduplication and preference decisions are clear; annotation-specific attention overload is not connected.
concepts.next_action: Add review-thread priority and digest linkage without creating a new concept.

concepts.title: Offline work, synchronization and conflict recovery
concepts.explanation: Local versus remote truth, conflict recovery and retry semantics are well described; real reconnection tests are absent.
concepts.next_action: Exercise duplicate-safe retry and concurrent-edit recovery on a representative implementation.

concepts.title: Data visualization and dashboards
concepts.explanation: Chart-choice decisions and accessible failure states are concise; no observed comprehension outcomes are provided.
concepts.next_action: Validate one chart-versus-table decision with an actual user task.

concepts.title: Mobile and adaptive platform UX
concepts.explanation: Adaptive rules and wireframe comparison matrices are thorough; overlapping responsive checklists make scanning harder.
concepts.next_action: Collapse duplicate adaptation checks and keep one target-specific test matrix.

concepts.title: Advanced interactions and reversible actions
concepts.explanation: Bulk actions, undo and drag alternatives are specific; expanded consolidation matrices add procedural bulk.
concepts.next_action: Keep the simplest-action decision first and move advanced worksheet detail behind it.

concepts.title: AI-powered experiences, transparency and calibrated trust
concepts.explanation: Provenance, uncertainty and correction are expressed as clear UX contracts; no model behavior has been evaluated here.
concepts.next_action: Attach scenario-based source and uncertainty checks when an implementation exists.

concepts.title: Agentic actions, approvals and reversible workflows
concepts.explanation: Risk-weighted approvals and side-effect boundaries are strong; no tool-backed approval workflow is verified.
concepts.next_action: Test interrupted and ambiguous action outcomes against an authorized tool flow.

concepts.title: Conversational, voice and multimodal UX
concepts.explanation: Modality fallback, transcript and interruption decisions are practical; voice usability evidence is absent.
concepts.next_action: Validate interruption and non-audio completion with representative input methods.

concepts.title: Performance, perceived speed and resilient task feedback
concepts.explanation: Field, lab and task readiness metrics are correctly distinguished; example performance results are not observed.
concepts.next_action: Attach an actual task-readiness and Core Web Vitals measurement record.

concepts.title: UX experimentation and causal evidence
concepts.explanation: Randomization, SRM, guardrails and inference boundaries are precise; this is a protocol, not a completed experiment.
concepts.next_action: Apply the pre-registration contract to a real comparison and record outcome limits.

concepts.title: Application architecture and scalability selection
concepts.explanation: Four architecture profiles and selection criteria are usable; external provenance and a worked transition are limited.
concepts.next_action: Add a source-scoped comparison and a small framework-specific selection example.

concepts.title: Application module boundaries and developer navigation
concepts.explanation: A clear purpose boundary, public-entrypoint example and developer task-location exercise make ownership decisions practical; sources remain platform-scoped and untested here.
concepts.next_action: Test the import rules and task-to-file lookup with unfamiliar contributors in a representative repository and report observed errors and time.

concepts.title: Application architecture evolution and fitness
concepts.explanation: An explicit fitness worksheet and incremental extraction example now connect architecture transitions to verifiable measures and practitioner sources; no actual baseline is supplied.
concepts.next_action: Document one real before-and-after task-location, import-boundary and regression record, with the measured environment and rollback outcome.

concepts.title: Enterprise and multi-application architecture
concepts.explanation: A topology choice table, source-scoped Google/Node/TypeScript/GitHub references, cross-app Dialog example and accountable release/rollback evidence make tradeoffs explicit and verifiable.
concepts.next_action: Test the selected topology on the actual organization and consumer graph, with owner approval, version compatibility, cross-app journeys and measured delivery cost.

concepts.title: Framework-aware application structure and route ownership
concepts.explanation: Next.js, Angular and React Router ownership examples are helpful; framework-version assumptions need periodic rechecking.
concepts.next_action: Pin example versions and add a lightweight update review cadence.

concepts.title: Application architecture enforcement and CI guardrails
concepts.explanation: Lint, dependency-cruiser and Nx recipes are specific; none is run here and the combined tutorial is lengthy.
concepts.next_action: Split tool choice from recipes and verify one ruleset against a sample repo.

concepts.title: Application architecture reference implementations and migrations
concepts.explanation: Three bounded architecture scenarios now have a clear selection gate, positive/negative import fixture, developer-task ownership exercise, platform sources and separate runtime evidence limits.
concepts.next_action: Apply the source-level import and task-location exercises to one pinned real repository; capture actual CI, keyboard, release and owner observations rather than assuming success.

concepts.title: Account and settings portal
concepts.explanation: The settings decision map makes navigation, authority, save and recovery choices immediately accessible; the many configuration subsections remain lengthy and partially overlapping.
concepts.next_action: Review and consolidate specialized configuration cases against their canonical owners; run one scope-change and unknown-save task scenario.

concepts.title: Billing, plans and subscription settings
concepts.explanation: Plan changes, invoices and billing recovery are covered concisely; provider and jurisdiction applicability is not yet validated.
concepts.next_action: Add a provider-neutral failed-payment scenario and a policy applicability check.

concepts.title: Wireframe methodology and prototype escalation
concepts.explanation: The malformed task-flows reference was repaired, while fidelity and evidence boundaries remain clear. A one-link correction does not justify an unearned dimension increase.
concepts.next_action: Apply the static-versus-interactive fidelity decision to a representative task and record observed limitations rather than inferring tested behavior.

concepts.title: Review Workspace
concepts.explanation: Task decisions and unknown outcomes are carefully modeled; the feature contract lacks a representative human review test.
concepts.next_action: Validate one approve, reject and unknown-outcome reconciliation task.

concepts.title: Combobox and autocomplete
concepts.explanation: The editable suggestion Enter-commit and Escape-cancel example adds active-descendant, popup and no-results checks to an already useful contract.
concepts.next_action: Exercise typing, Enter commit, Escape cancel, async no-results, touch selection and screen-reader focus in an actual combobox.

concepts.title: Radio group
concepts.explanation: The empty required delivery-choice case illustrates form-level validation, legend and group focus ownership without claiming tested behavior.
concepts.next_action: Verify the required empty group, associated error, arrow/Space selection, focus order and translated fieldset legend.

concepts.title: Switch and immediate toggle
concepts.explanation: The server-backed preference rejection example makes rollback, checked-state truth and error feedback testable; persistence remains unverified.
concepts.next_action: Exercise pending, rejected and retried saves with accessible checked truth, readable errors and no false success state.

concepts.title: Tabs and tab panels
concepts.explanation: The slow remote-panel example explains when manual activation prevents unwanted fetches and adds keyboard and focus acceptance criteria.
concepts.next_action: Validate manual Arrow, Home, End, Tab and Enter behavior, panel labels, pending states and focus continuity on slow loads.

concepts.title: Disclosure and accordion
concepts.explanation: Nested disclosure collapse now has an explicit child-focus recovery scenario, strengthening the keyboard and expanded-state acceptance contract.
concepts.next_action: Expand nested help, focus a descendant, collapse the parent and verify safe focus relocation, keyboard operation and text growth.

concepts.title: Textarea and long-form input
concepts.explanation: A multilingual autosave draft losing connectivity illustrates text growth, caret stability, conflict disclosure and safe resumption beyond a state inventory.
concepts.next_action: Test a long translated draft, offline autosave, reconnect conflict, intentional recovery and preserved caret/selection.

concepts.title: Menu button and action menu
concepts.explanation: The menu example now specifies disabled-item navigation, Escape dismissal and focus return, supplying useful acceptance details without runtime evidence.
concepts.next_action: Verify Arrow navigation, disabled actions, activation, Escape and focus restoration in a consuming menu with accessible names.

concepts.title: Date and time input
concepts.explanation: An explicit daylight-saving fallback case makes ambiguous instants and offset selection verifiable alongside locale and timezone guidance.
concepts.next_action: Test ambiguous fallback and nonexistent spring-forward times, checking user choice, errors, keyboard access and locale formats.

concepts.title: Tooltip
concepts.explanation: The hover/focus example clarifies why essential instructions cannot depend on a tooltip and names dismissal and touch checks.
concepts.next_action: Verify hover, focus, Escape, touch alternative and described-by semantics while keeping critical instructions persistent.

concepts.title: Popover and non-modal overlay
concepts.explanation: A nested nonmodal overlay case adds practical dismissal-stack, outside-interaction and focus criteria beyond generic popover semantics.
concepts.next_action: Test nested Escape ordering, outside clicks, background access, focus continuity and narrow-screen positioning in a consumer.

concepts.title: Slider and bounded range control
concepts.explanation: The coarse keyboard choice versus precise numeric-entry case helps agents decide when a slider is appropriate and what alternative to provide.
concepts.next_action: Verify Arrow, Home, End, value text, exact numeric entry, invalid values, touch and localized number format.

concepts.title: Hierarchical tree view
concepts.explanation: The typeahead-and-collapse case makes visible-ancestor focus recovery and virtualized-item checks more directly testable.
concepts.next_action: Exercise typeahead, collapse, Arrow navigation and focus retention on a virtualized tree with assistive technology.

concepts.title: Onboarding and first-use experiences
concepts.explanation: First-success and resumable onboarding decisions are concise; measured completion and abandonment are not available.
concepts.next_action: Test first-success with a skip and resume path.

concepts.title: File upload and attachment workflows
concepts.explanation: Transfer states and error recovery are well scoped; interrupted and duplicate uploads are not verified.
concepts.next_action: Exercise interrupted upload, retry and cancellation outcomes.

concepts.title: Collaboration and sharing
concepts.explanation: Invite, revoke and access truth are covered; delayed permission propagation needs a task-level check.
concepts.next_action: Test revoke visibility and unauthorized re-entry after the change.

concepts.title: Content creation and publishing
concepts.explanation: Draft, preview and publication transitions are outlined; concurrent changes and uncertain publish outcomes need tests.
concepts.next_action: Add an unknown publish acknowledgement and conflict-recovery case.

concepts.title: Scheduling and availability
concepts.explanation: Slots, recurrence and time zones are included; stale slot availability remains an unverified risk.
concepts.next_action: Test a slot that becomes unavailable before confirmation.

concepts.title: Purchasing and checkout journeys
concepts.explanation: Price review and uncertain payment outcomes are explicit; no live purchase recovery evidence is recorded.
concepts.next_action: Validate duplicate prevention and unknown payment result recovery.

concepts.title: Master-detail exploration
concepts.explanation: Decision-first single-surface chooser, scoped W3C/USWDS/GOV.UK sources, canonical aliases and seven observable MD-01–MD-07 checks cover the task's choices, exceptions and recovery without duplicating component behavior.
concepts.next_action: Ask an independent reviewer to run MD-01–MD-07 on a real product across desktop, mobile, screen reader and locale cases; record actual outcomes before changing E0 or lifecycle status.

concepts.title: Comparison and decision support
concepts.explanation: Aligned comparisons and consequence clarity are defined; decision-quality evidence is still hypothetical.
concepts.next_action: Test a comparison with materially different options and user priorities.

concepts.title: Content architecture, taxonomy and findability
concepts.explanation: Taxonomy and retrieval tradeoffs are clear; the mapping has no observed findability outcome.
concepts.next_action: Run a small label-discovery or tree-test task.

concepts.title: Inclusive design beyond conformance
concepts.explanation: Situational barriers and broader inclusion are acknowledged; the examples are not drawn from participant evidence.
concepts.next_action: Add one sourced barrier and the resulting design change.

concepts.title: Responsive spatial composition
concepts.explanation: Content-driven reflow and reading order are specific; actual zoom and narrow-container checks remain open.
concepts.next_action: Add a 320px and zoom/reflow verification record.

concepts.title: Information architecture validation
concepts.explanation: Card-sort and tree-test method boundaries are useful; no study result demonstrates the protocol.
concepts.next_action: Attach a representative tree test and its limitations.

concepts.title: Ethical motivation and engagement
concepts.explanation: The voluntary continue-or-exit learner example improves coverage of useful engagement and pressure-related harms without inventing a successful study.
concepts.next_action: Evaluate voluntary exit, comprehension and learning success with representative users, recording pressure and autonomy signals.

concepts.title: Design-system adoption and change management
concepts.explanation: The Field-error pilot scenario now ties catalog ownership to rollout, task baseline, fallback, support and a defined sunset decision; outcomes remain hypotheses.
concepts.next_action: Pilot a consequential form with named owners, measured recovery, support burden, rollback trigger and legacy retirement decision.

concepts.title: Data import and migration
concepts.explanation: Field mapping, preview, duplicates and reconciliation have explicit states; real import failure evidence is absent.
concepts.next_action: Verify partial-error preview and duplicate reconciliation against sample data.

concepts.title: Permissions and access requests
concepts.explanation: Request-versus-grant boundaries and decision states are precise; actual permission propagation is untested.
concepts.next_action: Test denial and pending access visibility from an unprivileged session.

concepts.title: Data export and background jobs
concepts.explanation: Long-running export states and secure retrieval are covered; expiry and access loss need demonstrated recovery.
concepts.next_action: Test an expired download and pending job after sign-out.

concepts.title: Commenting and annotations
concepts.explanation: Dense-review filtering, marker clustering, an accessible thread-list alternative and permission-sensitive counts now cover the missing decision; research and observed behavior remain limited.
concepts.next_action: Evaluate a representative dense-document task, including permission isolation, screen-reader navigation, filter recovery and detached anchors.

concepts.title: Reporting, moderation and appeals
concepts.explanation: Reporting, privacy-aware status and appeals are included; safety-sensitive escalation is untested.
concepts.next_action: Verify restricted visibility and appeal handoff with scenario-specific evidence.

concepts.title: Activity timelines and history
concepts.explanation: Actor/time/redaction context is explicit; busy timelines still need grouping and focus-behavior evidence.
concepts.next_action: Test grouped events and a keyboard navigable change history.

concepts.title: Rich-text editing
concepts.explanation: Semantic formatting, safe paste and drafts are scoped; long collaborative edits lack demonstrated recovery.
concepts.next_action: Exercise paste sanitization and draft restore after failure.

concepts.title: Real-time data and live updates
concepts.explanation: The burst-update pause and catch-up scenario makes freshness, announcement noise and focus stability more observable; product results remain unknown.
concepts.next_action: Exercise high-frequency updates with pause, catch-up, stable selection, screen-reader announcements and truthful freshness.

concepts.title: Workflow automation and rule builders
concepts.explanation: A paused-rule, failed-execution and replay case sharpens acceptance of uncertain outcomes and safe retries without asserting an implementation.
concepts.next_action: Test pause, failed execution and replay against audit truth, permission enforcement, duplication and accessible recovery.

concepts.title: Collection and feed views
concepts.explanation: The large filtered-collection case adds clearer expectations for stale results, focus return and meaningful filtering; real task performance is unknown.
concepts.next_action: Test filters, item-to-list focus return, empty/error states and narrow-screen selection with representative content.

concepts.title: Progress indicator
concepts.explanation: Measured versus unknown progress and completion semantics are explicit; no consuming application test is recorded.
concepts.next_action: Verify stage changes and completion announcements in a live task.

concepts.title: Listbox and multi-select options
concepts.explanation: Focus-versus-selection and keyboard semantics are precise; composite widget behavior has no runtime verification.
concepts.next_action: Test multi-select, typeahead and focus retention with assistive technology.
